translations.web: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.
translations.bsb: (But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had laid out there.)
translations.kjv: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
translations.asv: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
